summary: Retro pluck (openDAW's Vaporisateur preset): short game-ish synth pluck for arps and hooks in synthwave, pop, electro
label: Retro Pluck
body: Sixteenth-note arpeggios and short hooks in MIDI 60-88.

Register: MIDI 48-96 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: openDAW/Retro Pluck, openDAW's factory preset for Vaporisateur: make_instrument (sound "openDAW/Retro Pluck") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
